name: Cody Gakpo

career_stints.note: All-competitions career total through his January 2023 move to Liverpool (~£44m). Came through PSV's youth academy, debuted 2016; breakout 2021/22 Eredivisie season alone was 21 goals and 15 assists, earning him the Dutch Footballer of the Year award.

All-competitions, 2025/26 season. Premier League-only split: 36 matches, 2747 minutes, 7 goals, 5 assists, 87 shots (21 on target). Joined Liverpool January 2023; earlier seasons (2022/23 debut half-season: 21 PL apps/7 goals/3 assists; 2023/24: 35 league apps/8 goals/5 assists) are not combined into a single cumulative Liverpool total here, since a fully reliable cross-season all-competitions sum could not be resolved without risking double-counting -- the most recent complete season is used instead, consistent with this project's convention against guessing at aggregates. positions_played shares are a qualitative estimate (predominantly left wing, with striker minutes when deployed centrally), not a source-verified split.

notes: shots_per90 and xg_per90 (non-penalty) are 2025/26 Premier League figures via an xgstat.com search snippet (87 shots in 36 matches, 9.3 npxG, 0.85 xG+xA/90 -- he outperformed his npxG, scoring 7 goals from 9.3 npxG).
pass_accuracy_pct, progressive_passes_per90, touches_per90, duels_won_pct: no reliable season-specific figure found -- left null rather than guessed.
Sources: liverpoolfc.com, sportbusy.com, xgstat.com (via search), givemesport.com, fieldinsider.com, grokipedia.com (cross-check only, not primary), transfermarkt.us -- via web search 2026-08-10.
